sections.name: stanza 2
sections.text:
The winter has been long and quiet here. Snow on the iron bridge,
fog on the river, and the lamp in the window burning late.

sections.name: stanza 3
sections.text:
I keep your letter in my coat. I read it on the train
and the whole grey city seems to hum with something warm.

sections.name: stanza 4
sections.text:
Will you come home in spring?
The garden is waiting,
and so am I.
